newsitem.title: UK: UK wooltop quotations inflated by Australian dollar.
newsitem.headline: UK wooltop quotations inflated by Australian dollar.

text.p: Topmakers wove currency changes into their price quotations on Thursday, some asking for an extra thirteen pence per kg, Bradford market sources said.
A strong Australian dollar fuelled increases of between four and thirteen pence for all tops with the exception of English-woolled styles which were offered unchanged.
Traders said buyers were still resisting price rises and none had been prompted to seek fresh supplies after the latest round of increased quotations.
"Although a few traders have high hopes of an improvement in new business by the end of the week," one market commentator said. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
